entries.title: Jeremiah 18:1
segments: ¶The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying:

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:2
segments: "Arise and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause you to hear My words."

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:3
segments: Then I went down to the potter's house, and there he was, making something at the wheel.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:4
segments: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter; so he made it again into another vessel, as it seemed good to the potter to make.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:5
segments: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying:

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:6
segments: "O house of Israel, can I not do with you as this potter?" says the LORD. "Look, as the clay [is] in the potter's hand, so [are] you in My hand, O house of Israel!

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:7
segments: "The instant I speak concerning a nation and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, to pull down, and to destroy [it],

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:8
segments: "if that nation against whom I have spoken turns from its evil, I will relent of the disaster that I thought to bring upon it.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:9
segments: "And the instant I speak concerning a nation and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant [it],

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:10
segments: "if it does evil in My sight so that it does not obey My voice, then I will relent concerning the good with which I said I would benefit it.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:11
segments: ¶"Now therefore, speak to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, 'Thus says the LORD: "Behold, I am fashioning a disaster and devising a plan against you. Return now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good."'"

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:12
segments: And they said, "That is hopeless! So we will walk according to our own plans, and we will every one obey the dictates of his evil heart."

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:13
segments: Therefore thus says the LORD: "Ask now among the Gentiles, Who has heard such things? The virgin of Israel has done a very horrible thing.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:14
segments: Will [a man] leave the snow water of Lebanon, [Which comes] from the rock of the field? Will the cold flowing waters be forsaken for strange waters?

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:15
segments: "Because My people have forgotten Me, They have burned incense to worthless idols. And they have caused themselves to stumble in their ways, [From] the ancient paths, To walk in pathways and not on a highway,

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:16
segments: To make their land desolate [and] a perpetual hissing; Everyone who passes by it will be astonished And shake his head.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:17
segments: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will show them the back and not the face In the day of their calamity."

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:18
segments: ¶Then they said, "Come and let us devise plans against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come and let us attack him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words."

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:19
segments: Give heed to me, O LORD, And listen to the voice of those who contend with me!

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:20
segments: Shall evil be repaid for good? For they have dug a pit for my life. Remember that I stood before You To speak good for them, To turn away Your wrath from them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:21
segments: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, And pour out their [blood] By the force of the sword; Let their wives [become] widows And bereaved of their children. Let their men be put to death, Their young men [be] slain By the sword in battle.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:22
segments: Let a cry be heard from their houses, When You bring a troop suddenly upon them; For they have dug a pit to take me, And hidden snares for my feet.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:23
segments: Yet, LORD, You know all their counsel Which is against me, to slay [me]. Provide no atonement for their iniquity, Nor blot out their sin from Your sight; But let them be overthrown before You. Deal [thus] with them In the time of Your anger.
